answer: Track long-term goal pursuit: each agent declares a goal and the network watches how it works toward it over many epochs — its milestones, setbacks, and changes of plan. A prism splits real goals into varied paths, while a thousand Sybils chase the same declared goal in the same mechanical steps, forming a single nebula of identical trajectories. A juniper grows slowly and unevenly; a fake's progress is a straight line drawn by a script. The network rewards varied, persistent pursuit and flags identical paths, so each fake must pursue a different goal over time — real work, not duplication.
